subject: Fiscal Year 2026 Budget Submission
overview: The Medford City Council received the Mayor's proposed Fiscal Year 2026 budget of $235,093,352 and tabled it for future discussion. The Council also voted on several grants of location, zoning ordinance updates, and free cash appropriations.

items.title: Medford High School Orchestra and Middle School String Ensemble Commendation
items.summary: Approved a resolution congratulating the orchestras on their gold medals and inviting the high school group to perform at the meeting.

items.title: Memorial Day Commemoration Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution honoring veterans and commemorating those who lost their lives in service this Memorial Day.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2026 Budget Submission
items.summary: Tabled the Mayor's proposed $235,093,352 operating and enterprise budget to June 10th after an initial presentation and discussion.

items.title: Approval of Meeting Records
items.summary: Approved the records of the May 13, 2025 meeting.

items.title: Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved reports from the Planning and Permitting Committee, Public Works and Facilities Committee, and Committee of the Whole budget meetings.

items.title: Public Hearing: 82 Mystic Avenue Special Permit Amendment
items.summary: Continued the public hearing regarding the Clear Channel billboard special permit amendment to the June 10th meeting.

items.title: Public Hearing: Zoning Amendments for Residential Districts
items.summary: Opened and continued the public hearing on residential zoning amendments to June 10th, pending recommendations from the Community Development Board.

items.title: Grant of Location: National Grid Gas Main on Washington Street
items.summary: Approved a grant of location with conditions for National Grid to install a gas main on Washington Street, Washington Place, and Cross Street.

items.title: Grant of Location: National Grid Utility Pole Relocation on Boston Avenue
items.summary: Approved a grant of location with conditions to relocate five utility poles near 401 Boston Avenue to accommodate a Tufts University dormitory project.

items.title: Voluntary Excise Tax Donations for Veterans
items.summary: Adopted state provisions to allow voluntary donations on excise tax bills to support in-need veterans.

items.title: Accessory Dwelling Units Zoning Amendments Referral
items.summary: Referred the proposed accessory dwelling unit zoning updates to the Community Development Board.

items.title: 2024 Surveillance Annual Report and License Plate Reader Policy
items.summary: Approved both the 2024 Surveillance Annual Report and the parking department's license plate reader use policy.

items.title: Monthly ICE Activity Report Resolution
items.summary: Tabled a resolution that would require monthly reports from the police chief on Immigration and Customs Enforcement activity in Medford.

items.title: Free Cash Appropriation: Kiosks and Soil Remediation
items.summary: Approved a free cash appropriation of $150,859.98 for parking kiosk replacements and soil remediation at 448 High Street.

items.title: Non-Union Personnel Wage Adjustment
items.summary: Approved for first reading a 2% base salary increase for non-union personnel.

items.title: Five-Year Ricoh Copier Contract
items.summary: Approved a five-year contract with Ricoh USA Inc. for copier and printer leases in the school department.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Heard comments from residents concerning police accountability and the newly hired city solicitor.
